label: Bible Study
prompt: And they shall be mine, saith the LORD of hosts, in that day when I make up my _____; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.
verse: And they shall be mine, saith the LORD of hosts, in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.
note: God's book of remembrance for those who feared him — they become his treasured jewels.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Grace be with you, _____, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
verse: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
note: John's greeting hands over three gifts at once — grace, mercy, and peace — in truth and love.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with _____?
verse: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?
note: God's nature tour for Job includes the warhorse — its neck 'clothed with thunder,' where modern versions say mane.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and _____ to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.
verse: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.
note: Ezra hearing of Israel's intermarriage with idolaters tore his clothes and prayed red-faced.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Set thee up _____, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.
verse: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.
note: Exiles were told to 'set thee up waymarks' on the road out of Israel — so they could find their way back home.
